anchorReview.visual: The mutation remains a temporary Audralia arrival overlay and strengthens the established H-Earth-family world-initialization language with a visibly chromatic blue, violet, teal and gold treatment plus explicit COLOR ARRIVAL v4 build identity. It does not substitute a dashboard, map application, or separate product for the world.
anchorReview.interaction: No camera, travel, look, gesture, world navigation, renderer geometry, or world interaction behavior is changed. Loader-progress changes only expose delayed startup after 15 seconds and an already-recorded reconciliation initialization error.
anchorReview.continuity: The same five-stage runtime predicates remain authoritative for world readiness. The loader still resolves into the same canonical Audralia world and does not create a parallel world or alternate route.
